_about: RSSSF's Malawi internationals page (malaw-intres.html) -> the nt_matches vocabulary. Written by hand; scripts/rsssf_nt.py never guesses, and a printed name, venue code or competition code missing here stops the parse and is named.
_opponents: Keyed by the printed name, case-folded (RSSSF capitalises competitive matches, so 'ZAMBIA' and 'Zambia' are one team). 'name' is what renders: the name the country had at the time (Swaziland, Zaire, Southern Rhodesia), with RSSSF's house abbreviations spelled out and its capitals dropped — 'SAO TOME/PRIN.' is styling, not a name anyone used. 'country' groups head-to-head records across a rename (Swaziland and Eswatini are one record; so are Zaire and DR Congo), and is checked against RSSSF's own by-country table: Southern Rhodesia stays apart from Zimbabwe and Northern Rhodesia from Zambia because RSSSF keeps them apart. A B or CHAN side is its own country — they are all unofficial anyway. 'home' is the venue code(s) where a match against them is an AWAY match; any code that is neither MWL nor one of these is a neutral ground.
_table_names: RSSSF's by-country table spells a few countries its own way; everything else matches a 'country' above case-insensitively.
_venues: Venue code -> the country the match was played in, as it was called then. 'before' maps a date (exclusive) to the earlier name: Zambia was Northern Rhodesia until 24 Oct 1964, Zimbabwe was Southern Rhodesia until 18 Apr 1980, Eswatini was Swaziland until 19 Apr 2018. MWL is Malawi throughout, as RSSSF writes it, pre-independence rows included. SUD is South Sudan and SDN is Sudan: RSSSF's only SUD row is the 2021 South Sudan qualifier.
_competitions: RSSSF's code (the COMP column with any stage and '*' removed) -> nt_matches.competition, in the vocabulary the men's rows already use ('World Cup Qualification', 'AFCON Qualification', 'COSAFA Cup', 'Friendly'). 'WCQ/CANQ' is the 2006 and 2010 joint qualifiers, which RSSSF counts in its World Cup figures only. An 'XXX IND' code is that country's independence tournament. MOZ, ZIM and KEN Cup are tournaments RSSSF names only by host — named so here rather than guessed at.
_competitive: Which competition codes RSSSF's COMPETITIVE SUMMARY counts, and under which line. Used only by the check.
_corrections: Lines where the page contradicts itself and two of its own statements outvote the third. 'line' is the start of the printed line; 'set' overrides parsed fields (empty: the line is right as read and only its result letter is the typo). Settled from the page alone, never from memory.

corrections.reason: Printed 'w 1-1'. RSSSF's Kenya row counts it a draw and one scorer is named, so the score stands and the W is the typo.

Printed 'd 1-1' with two Malawi scorers (V. Phiri, H. Mwakasungula). RSSSF's Eswatini row counts one more win and one more goal (11 won, 40 scored) than a draw would give, so two of the page's three statements say 2-1.

_table_differences: Where the page's lines and its hand-kept summary disagree and the page cannot say which is right. RSSSF's summary does not agree with ITSELF — its country rows add up to D199 L249 F790 A838, its TOTAL line says D201 L247 F793 A840 — so it cannot be the answer key it is for a season's final table. The site follows the lines. Figures are P W D L F A (and the year last met, for a country row); scripts/rsssf_nt.py fails if a difference appears that is not here, or one here moves or goes away. A note naming a candidate line is a lead for a person to check, not a finding.

LESOTHO.reason: The table leaves out the 2 Mar 1976 friendly abandoned at 53' (0-1). It keeps the 2000 Kenya qualifier abandoned at 87', so RSSSF has no one rule for abandoned matches.

SAO TOME e PRINCIPE.reason: RSSSF's row is impossible: one win and one defeat from 3 goals scored concede at least two. The lines are 3-1 (6 Jun 2024) and 0-1 (13 Oct 2025).

ZAMBIA.reason: Not settled. The lines file ten more matches under Zambia than the table does; the table has nine more under Zimbabwe and one more under Southern Rhodesia than the lines. The three add to the same 143 matches, but the moved results are not the same results, so this is not one block relabelled.

ETHIOPIA.reason: One 1-1 draw the table files under Ethiopia and the lines under Tanzania (see TANZANIA). Lead: 04/12/10 v Ethiopia and 02/12/11 v Tanzania are both CECAFA 1-1 draws in Tanzania with 'H.Kabicha 27' — one may be a copy of the other.

MOROCCO.reason: The lines concede two more than the table, and the competitive summary's Nations Cup Qualifiers line is two short the same way, so the gap is in one of the six Morocco qualifiers. Not settled.

UGANDA.reason: The table concedes one more than the lines. Not settled.

YEMEN.reason: The table counts the 12 May 2010 friendly in Yemen (0-1), which its line marks '*'. The site follows the '*'.

SOUTHERN RHODESIA.reason: The table has one draw more than the lines and no goals more: the 21 Jun 1964 friendly (2-2, marked '*') counted in P and D but not in F and A. Northern Rhodesia's row has the same slip.

NORTHERN RHODESIA.reason: Two defeats and the goals of one: the 4 Jul 1964 Independence match (0-5, marked '*') counted in P and L only.

TOTAL.reason: The sum of the differences above, plus RSSSF's TOTAL line not matching its own country rows (see _table_differences).
